Employer paid Short Term Disability + $50,000 Life Insurance. Parental leave: 12 weeks of company paid primary caregiver leave, 3 weeks of company paid secondary caregiver leave, $1,500 new parent bonus, and 4 week flexible return to work plan. Wellbeing support: Subsidized up to 80% ClassPass subscription. Referral bonus: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent. You can work directly with both technical and non-technical leaders, adapting your communication to be concise and clear. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/polymarket/5d32.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is launching perpetual futures and we're looking for a Senior Web Engineer to own the frontend of our perps product. You'll build the trading interfaces that traders will rely on every day: order entry, position management, real-time market data, and the full suite of UI that makes a great perps exchange feel fast, reliable, and intuitive. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of frontend product development, backend systems, performance, and reliability. We want someone who has shipped trading UIs before, understands the domain deeply, and can move fast without compromising quality. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own and ship complex trading UI features end-to-end — order books, position panels, trade history, funding rates, liquidation displays, and more — making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability - Work closely with backend engineers to design APIs, reason through real-time data flows, and build reliable trading experiences on top of complex exchange systems - Partner with QA, TPM, product, and design to clarify requirements, manage launches, and improve product quality - Monitor dashboards, alerts, and user reports to identify and respond to issues quickly; work with backend and infrastructure teams during incidents to isolate root causes and follow through with fixes - Design and implement UI that handles live market data, streaming order books, and fast-moving prices in a way that feels responsive and accurate to traders - Build and improve the logs, metrics, alerts, dashboards, and error reporting that give the team visibility into frontend system performance - Identify meaningful technical debt, propose pragmatic refactors, and contribute to system design discussions that evolve our frontend architecture as the product scales WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 3–5+ years of frontend web engineering experience - Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend development - Experience building trading, exchange, or financial product UIs — you understand the domain and know what a great trading interface requires - Strong frontend system design instincts across state management, data fetching, caching, performance, reliability, and maintainability - Experience working with real-time data: WebSockets, streaming APIs, or live market feeds - Strong debugging skills and experience responding to production issues - Comfortable working with backend engineers on APIs, data contracts, failure modes, and system behavior - High agency — you notice problems, propose solutions, and drive work to completion - Clear communicator during planning, launches, bugs, and incidents - (Plus) Direct experience building UI for a perpetuals exchange or derivatives trading product - (Plus) Frontend performance specialization, particularly around real-time data rendering - Senior Product Manager, AI Platform – Equity Research VERSANT is an independent, publicly traded company that brings together powerhouse brands such as CNBC, MS NOW (formerly MSNBC), USA Network, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Golf Channel, along with dynamic digital and direct-to-consumer brands such as Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, and GolfPass. We operate like a startup—a small team with high ownership, fast decisions, and direct access to leadership—while benefiting from the resources and long-term commitment of a well-capitalized public company. Our mission is simple: help millions of individual investors make better investment decisions. We’re combining AI, institutional-quality investment research, proprietary data, and exceptional engineering to redefine how retail investors discover, research, and evaluate stocks. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with deep experience building consumer investing, financial research, or market-data products to help us build a new generation of AI-powered equity research products. This role sits at the intersection of consumer fintech, public equities, financial data, and AI. You will work with a high-caliber team that brings together top-tier engineering and buy-side investing talent, including analysts with prior experience at firms such as Millennium, Point72, and KKR. In this role, you will own and shape core product experiences across our AI equity research platform, particularly products that help investors discover stocks, conduct research, compare opportunities, understand investment theses, and build conviction. These may include AI-powered research reports, stock recommendations, screeners and discovery tools, company pages, watchlists, portfolio insights, and conversational research experiences. This is a hands-on product role for someone who wants to stay close to users, product details, data, and execution. You do not need to have worked professionally as an equity analyst, but you should be an active individual investor with strong public-markets fluency. You should understand how investors move from discovering a stock to researching the business, evaluating valuation and risk, comparing alternatives, and ultimately making an investment decision. You will identify the highest-value customer problems, define product requirements, validate assumptions with users and data, and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Equity Research to ship experiences that make institutional-quality research accessible and actionable for a large retail investor audience. The team is part of a new organization, which means you will have meaningful influence over both the products we build and the product culture we establish. We believe in deeply understanding customer needs and behaviors, empowering product teams to solve meaningful problems, shipping useful products quickly, and iterating based on real user feedback and behavior. This is an opportunity to take significant ownership early and grow quickly as the platform and team scale. What You’ll Do Own and evolve core stock research and discovery experiences across StockStory’s AI-powered investing platform. Develop a deep understanding of our users through regular interviews, usability testing, behavioral analysis, and other forms of product discovery. Study how individual investors discover ideas, research companies, evaluate financial performance and valuation, compare stocks, build conviction, monitor investments, and make buy/sell decisions. Translate customer problems, investing workflows, competitive insights, and behavioral data into clear product opportunities, requirements, roadmaps, and execution plans. Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Equity Research to build products that combine AI, financial data, and expert investment research into simple and compelling consumer experiences. Play an integral role in defining our AI product experience, including how AI-generated research and recommendations communicate reasoning, evidence, sources, assumptions, uncertainty, and risk. Help establish product standards for trust and quality in AI-generated financial research, working with our investment and technical teams to determine how outputs are evaluated before and after launch. Build and improve products such as AI research reports, stock discovery and screening tools, company research experiences, investment recommendations, watchlists, portfolio insights, and conversational research interfaces. Define clear success metrics for the products you own, including relevant activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and research-behavior metrics. Analyze funnels and user behavior, run experiments, synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback, and iterate quickly based on what users actually do. Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape across consumer brokerages, investing platforms, financial research products, market-data tools, and emerging AI investing products. Communicate product strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, decisions, results, and progress clearly across Product, Design, Engineering, Equity Research, and senior leadership. What We’re Looking For Minimum of 5 years of product management experience, including meaningful experience building B2C investing, brokerage, financial research, market-data, or investment-information products. Preferred experience from consumer investing or financial-information platform. Demonstrated experience owning products used by self-directed retail investors, ideally across one or more of the following areas: stock discovery, screeners, equity research, market data, company/fundamental data, watchlists, portfolio analytics, investment recommendations, financial news, or AI-powered investing tools. Strong public-equities fluency. You should understand financial statements, earnings, valuation multiples, consensus estimates, catalysts, investment theses, and the basic process investors use to evaluate public companies. Proven ability to take consumer product features from discovery through launch and iteration, including customer interviews, problem definition, PRDs/product requirements, prioritization, engineering execution, launch planning, experimentation, and post-launch measurement. Experience building high-engagement consumer or subscription products, with a strong understanding of activation, engagement, retention, conversion, and the behaviors that drive recurring product usage. Strong quantitative product instincts and experience using behavioral data, funnels, cohort analysis, experimentation, and product metrics to make decisions and evaluate launches. Experience working with data-intensive products and translating complex information into consumer experiences that are intuitive, useful, and trustworthy. Experience building AI-powered consumer products or features is strongly preferred. You should understand the opportunities and product challenges associated with LLM-generated content, including accuracy, explainability, source attribution, user trust, latency, and evaluation. Exceptional product judgment and attention to detail. You should be able to combine customer research, quantitative evidence, competitive insight, and your own judgment to determine what should—and should not—be built. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate user problems, product rationale, requirements, tradeoffs, metrics, and launch plans to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. High agency and a builder mentality. You are comfortable operating with incomplete information, making decisions, getting into the details, and moving quickly in an early-stage environment. https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/brainpo.description: For over two decades, BrainPOP has been trusted by educators and parents worldwide as a source of engaging and impactful learning experiences for all kids. With a presence in over two-thirds of U.S. districts through school and district subscriptions and an estimated annual reach of 25 million students, BrainPOP is empowering kids to take agency over their learning and excel in and out of the classroom. The company was acquired in 2022 by KIRKBI, the family-owned holding and investment company of the LEGO brand, marking a significant milestone as their first acquisition in the digital learning realm. We are thrilled to continue making learning fun and accessible with the strategic guidance and support of KIRKBI. About the Role Reporting to the Director, Quality Assurance, the Senior QA Engineer will join a squad (engineers and a product manager) that owns core identity and account systems powering the product, ensuring users can securely access and move through the platform. You'll bring technical expertise, a leadership mindset, and a commitment to continuous improvement to drive quality engineering through scalable test automation and API validation. You will own quality for the squad's work, develop a deep understanding of the surface area to advocate for customers, and evolve critical automation infrastructure, with particular focus on our Playwright-based testing framework. As a Senior QA Engineer, you will work independently on business-critical projects and lead QA efforts for complex, high-stakes initiatives. This squad's systems sit upstream of login, access, and data sync for every user on the platform, so reliability here has outsized impact. Your contributions are measurable at the company level: faster and more reliable delivery cycles, earlier defect detection, fewer production regressions, and greater confidence in release quality. Whether through advancing automation coverage, refining test strategy, or scaling tooling, your work helps teams ship with greater speed and fewer surprises. The preferred candidate will be within commutable distance of our NYC HQ and spend at least one day in the office weekly. Candidates based in the Eastern time zone may also be considered. You Will: Leadership & Influence: Shape test strategy in partnership with engineering and product leadership, and influence decisions that affect delivery speed, stability, and user experience on business-critical initiatives. Technical Ownership: Own and advance key parts of BrainPOP's test automation ecosystem, with a focus on our Playwright framework. Improve coverage, reliability, and speed through maintainable, scalable code and infrastructure. Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, and Engineering to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle. Participate in onboarding, architectural reviews, and initiatives that raise engineering standards across teams. Continuous Improvement & Knowledge Sharing: Champion quality engineering best practices through documentation, internal tech talks, and process refinement. Surface and introduce tools, workflows, and patterns that raise the bar org-wide. System Quality & Risk Management: Own the health of the end-to-end system. Proactively identify, investigate, and resolve issues, escalating when needed, so releases ship fast and with confidence. You Are An articulate communicator with sharp analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills. Energized by finding, regressing, and resolving issues before they reach customers. Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders simultaneously and a genuine team player. Curious about emerging technologies and quick to evaluate how they can strengthen QA processes. Confident navigating ambiguity, strategic about when to escalate, and able to influence outcomes across squads through reliability and presence. On Your Resume 4-6 years testing complex web-based applications, including preparing, documenting, and executing test criteria, test cases, test scripts, and test plans across the full product development lifecycle. 4-6 years writing and executing automated tests in JavaScript with a modern test automation framework; hands-on Playwright experience strongly preferred. Practical experience using AI-assisted tools in your day-to-day testing workflow — e.g., using tools like Claude Code to generate test scaffolding, accelerate debugging/triage, or build lightweight internal tooling that speeds up QA work. Experience testing authentication, authorization, or identity-adjacent systems (SSO, OAuth/SAML, session management, permissions) and/or systems that integrate with third-party platforms (LMS rostering, CRM, payment processors) strongly preferred. Location The BrainPOP team operates in a hybrid work environment: Each role has remote flexibility and an in-person component at our New York headquarters or other meeting locations. Based on the requirements of a specific role, we may prioritize hiring within a commutable distance of our New York headquarters or in another region relevant to that role. We can employ individuals residing in the following approved hiring states: Arizona California Connecticut Florida Georgia Illinois Massachusetts Minnesota Missouri New Jersey New York North Carolina Ohio Oregon Pennsylvania South Carolina Tennessee Texas Washington We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location. We have competitive pay bands for all other countries based on market standards. Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. Based on these factors, we expect most of the candidates offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description, as posted. If so, the updated salary range will be communicated to you as a candidate. USA Pay Scale $100,000—$120,000 USD Life at BrainPOP At BrainPOP, our work directly impacts how teachers teach and students learn. They inspire us to build solutions that facilitate joy and meaningful learning outcomes. Our commitment to educators and kids is reflected in our dedication to the BrainPOP team: ensuring their experience is empowering, creative, collaborative, playful, and anchored in learning and growth. Our team is made up of educators, data scientists, published authors, engineers, artists, bakers, film buffs, cyclists, dual citizens, and so much more. We value diversity and inclusion, collaboration, and learning from multiple perspectives. We believe that a diverse organization is a more effective organization. BrainPOP is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. NOTICE: We have become aware of various fraudulent websites and third parties impersonating our company and offering false job opportunities. These offers are not affiliated with BrainPOP and are considered part of an unlawful recruitment scam. To ensure your safety and protect your personal information we strongly recommend that you only apply for positions through the official BrainPOP website or BrainPOP's official LinkedIn page. If you receive any job offers or communications that do not originate from this page or our official e-mail domain brainpop.com, please treat them as suspicious and do not engage or provide any personal information. For any questions or to report suspicious activity, please contact us directly at legal@brainpop.com. While we have reported this general fraud to the authorities, you can report this fraud on your own behalf to the Federal Trade Commission (https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/) and the Federal Bureau of Investigation’ s Internet Crime Complaint Center (https://www.ic3.gov/).

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/rox-data-corp/b.description: ABOUT ROX At Rox, we believe in empowering people to do their best work. Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to handle the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x'd engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work. We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world's first revenue operating system — from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving into orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle. Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition. Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission — with an unreasonable commitment to doing whatever it takes to make it a reality. Nothing is possible without the world-class team assembled to redefine how businesses operate. THE ROLE We’re hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to be the analytical backbone of our GTM engine. As we scale from where we are today through the next 18-months, the decisions that determine how we scale our organization, how we incentivize the field, how we cut territories, where we set pipeline targets, and how we know week-to-week whether we’re on track, need a rigorous analyst who is also a pragmatic operator. This is a high-ownership, high-visibility seat that reports to and partners closely with the VP of Revenue Operations and Finance. You’ll own commission and quota planning, and you’ll be a core analytical partner on territory design and sales performance analytics. You will define the foundations that enable us to have a data driven command of our GTM, and your work will drive decisions that show up in the board deck. We’re an AI-first company, and we expect RevOps to operate that way too. You’ll be encouraged to reach for AI and automation before spreadsheets and manual process — using our own platform, agents and modern tooling to model, analyze, and report faster than a traditional ops team ever could. We’d rather you build a repeatable, AI-driven system than a one-off analysis. WHAT YOU’LL DO 1. Commission & quota planning (owner) You’ll own the analytics behind how we set quotas and how we pay for performance. That means modeling quota-setting across roles and segments, designing and pressure-testing comp plans against budget and behavior, running quota and comp scenarios for planning cycles, and administering the mechanics of the plans in partnership with Finance. You’ll lean on AI and automation to run scenarios and keep plans current in near-real time, and you’ll make sure incentives, cost of sale, and attainment all line up — and that reps and leadership trust the numbers. 2. Territory analysis & design Partnering with the VP of Revenue Operations and Finance, you’ll provide the analytical horsepower behind how we carve up the market and deploy our sellers. That means building AI-assisted account-scoring and segmentation logic, sizing territories for balance and fairness, modeling capacity and coverage against our growth plan, and supporting the territory carve for the second half of this year and the multi-year path out to FY28. The VP of RevOps owns the territory strategy; you make it defensible with the underlying analysis and turn it into concrete territory maps as we grow. 3. GTM performance analytics & reporting You’ll support the GTM performance picture end to end, working with the VP of RevOps and Finance to build and maintain it — favoring AI-driven, self-updating reporting over manual dashboards wherever possible. This includes: - Pipeline generation target setting — building the models that set PipeGen targets by segment, team, and rep, and pressure-testing them against historical conversion and coverage ratios. - Attribution tracking & analysis — instrumenting and analyzing how pipeline and revenue get created across channels and motions, so we can invest where it works. - GTM performance / KPI tracking & reporting — building the dashboards, funnel analytics, and forecasts leadership relies on, and helping run the recurring business reviews (weekly/monthly/quarterly) that keep the org honest against plan. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - A teammate that is excited to work together IRL out of our SF HQ daily. - 3+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Strategy & Analytics, Finance, or a comparable analytical role — ideally at a high-growth B2B SaaS company. - An AI-first operator’s mindset. You instinctively reach for AI, agents, and automation to do the work faster and better, and you’re excited to build RevOps on top of Rox’s own product. - Deep comfort with quantitative modeling. You can build a comp plan, a quota model, or a territory carve from a blank spreadsheet, and you can defend every assumption in it. - Fluency in the GTM data stack — hands-on CRM experience (Salesforce or HubSpot), and comfort in a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar). SQL is a strong plus. - Strong grasp of core GTM metrics: pipeline coverage, conversion and win rates, ramp, capacity/coverage, attainment, and cost of sale. - Excellent judgment and communication. You can take an ambiguous leadership question, structure it, do the analysis, and come back with a clear recommendation — not just a chart. - High ownership and low ego. You’re comfortable owning a metric and a cadence, chasing down the data, and driving a decision to close in a fast-moving environment. BONUS POINTS - You’ve run a quota/comp planning cycle or a territory carve end to end. - Experience with commissions tooling (CaptivateIQ, Spiff, QuotaPath) or planning tools. - Early-stage experience developing RevOps processes rather than inheriting them. - Hands-on experience using AI tools or agents to automate analysis, reporting, or ops workflows. - SQL and light scripting (Python) to work with data directly. Rox is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills, and perspectives, and we make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills. - Ownership: Thrive in ambiguous, adversarial environments and take ownership from problem definition through execution. https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/lilasci.description: Your Impact at LILA You will build the back-end and data foundations of the systems that schedule work across our autonomous labs, model them as digital twins, and turn raw experimental output into trustworthy, queryable data. Model digital twins: stand up the simulation/digital-twin data layer so teams predict factory behavior before committing resources. Own technical data management: build the Flyte pipelines, S3 lakehouse, and PostgreSQL models that turn instrument output into governed, trustworthy data. Enable data science: ship batch and event-driven pipelines that put clean data in the hands of scientists and models. Deliver capacity planning: create customer-facing services that help teams forecast factory capacity. Data engineering: pipelines on a workflow orchestrator such as Flyte, Temporal, or similar. Data modeling across stores: hands-on SQL (PostgreSQL), object storage (S3), and data lakehouse architectures. Cloud-native delivery: a major cloud with containers, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD — ideally AWS EKS (Docker/ECR), Terraform, and GitHub Actions. End-to-end ownership: taking services from design through delivery, reliability, and iteration. Clear collaboration: communicating technical tradeoffs plainly with engineers, scientists, and business partners. Bonus Points For Systems engineering in regulated industries: systems-thinking rigor in safety- or quality-critical settings — aerospace, manufacturing, or healthcare/life sciences. Scheduling & optimization: job scheduling, resource allocation, or constraint/optimization problems. Data-science enablement: distributed compute (Ray), experiment tracking (Weights & Biases), or model serving. Event-driven messaging: NATS, MQTT, or similar pub/sub for high-volume telemetry. https://www.amazon.jobs/en/jobs/10495604.description: Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable. The Sustainability Reporting, Enablement and Governance (S-REG) team's mission is to build a lasting, scalable and trusted sustainability reporting infrastructure to satisfy regulatory requirements and stakeholder expectations. We translate external requirements into internal needs and build tools and mechanisms that enable Amazon businesses to meet their Sustainability reporting obligations and effectively manage their Sustainability risks and opportunities. We are looking for a result-oriented, self-starter Business Analyst who is passionate about using data and automation to simplify complex sustainability reporting. You bring a builder mindset, a clear point of view on how AI tools can support and scale analytical work, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity - structuring problems, reaching defensible conclusions, and documenting clearly. You are the analytical owner for how we validate and make sense of disclosure data across sustainability domains - including but not limited to carbon, energy, water, waste, and workforce. You will build deep contextual knowledge of those measurement and accounting systems and define the completeness, accuracy, correlation, and causality analyses that turn raw, multi-source data into disclosure-ready information; prototype those analyses on real data; ensure data quality through scalable testing; draw correlations across domains (and against financials) in a way that is rigorous and makes business sense; and partner with our internal tech teams to scale the winning solutions. Your work directly determines whether Amazon can produce sustainability disclosures that are accurate, explainable, and defensible under external assurance. Key job responsibilities Extract, transform, and present data from upstream systems for internal pre-reviews, statutory reporting, and external disclosures across sustainability domains (carbon, energy, water, waste, workforce). Develop and implement scalable testing mechanisms for internal pre-review examinations and assurance readiness - completeness, accuracy, and reconciliation checks that flag defects early and prioritize them by materiality. Evaluate and improve data collection and ingestion processes, proposing solutions that enhance scalability and eliminate redundancies - including the right detection and prevention rules to embed in upstream systems so defects are caught (or avoided) at the source. Draw correlations across domains (and against financials) in a way that is rigorous and makes business sense, so reported trends are explainable and defensible under external assurance. Rapidly prototype new analytics and validation approaches (including with GenAI tooling) to prove value on real data, then hand well-specified requirements to internal tech partners to build and scale. Partner cross-functionally with data providers and measurement teams, report owners, and controllership - translating complex data-quality findings into plain language for non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders. Own the analytics that validate whether upstream controls are operating as intended (e.g., completeness of automated checks, detection of bypass or override), partnering with controllership teams to specify control requirements for new solutions before they move to production.
